crossRefs.note: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.
crossRefs.keyword: deny me not. Heb. turn not away my face

crossRefs.note: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.
crossRefs.keyword: deny me not. Heb. turn not away my face

translations.web: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”
translations.bsb: So now I have just one request of you; do not deny me.” “State your request,” she told him.
translations.kjv: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
translations.asv: And now I ask one petition of thee; deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
